records.failureSummary: Added/verified AC-numbered unit tests for parseDuration core parsing in test/duration.test.mjs (12 tests) and ran the suite green. Coverage: [AC-01] valid combinations 1h30m=5400000 and 1h30m20s=5420000; [AC-02] individual units 1h=3600000, 1m=60000, 1s=1000, 1ms=1 plus case-insensitivity (1H 30M) and ms not parsed as m+s; [AC-03] spaces between segments 1h 30m=5400000 and 1h 30m 20s=5420000; [AC-04] plain numbers 500=500 and 0=0; [AC-05] unparseable input returns null without throwing. npm test (project script node --test) reports 12 tests, 12 pass, 0 fail, exit 0; npm run build and npm run lint (node --check) exit 0. pnpm test itself exits 127 with sh: 1: pnpm: not found because pnpm is not installed in the sandbox; since package.json defines test as node --test, the underlying command was exercised directly via nm test. No product code was modified; src/duration.mjs was left untouched.
